localizedDescription.en: Opentorrent is a cross-platform qBittorrent client for iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and web.
localizedDescription.zh: Opentorrent 是一款跨平台 qBittorrent 客户端，支持 iOS、macOS、Windows、Linux、Android 和 Web。
localizedDescription.ru: Opentorrent — кроссплатформенный клиент qBittorrent для iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Android и веба.

platformInstall.Android: Use RepStore to install from our repository. Visit https://gitlab.com/HttpAnimations/repstore for installation instructions.
platformInstall.macOS: Install via Homebrew: brew tap Openlyst/macos https://github.com/HttpAnimation/Openlyst-more-builds?tab=readme-ov-file#homebrew-macoslinux.git && brew install --cask opentorrent
platformInstall.Windows: Download source and compile yourself from GitLab pipeline.
platformInstall.Linux: Download the latest Linux build from GitLab CI.

localizedDescription.en:
# 2.0.0

- fixed sub-buttons on ios theme
- fixed navbar white coloured on ios
- better iso support
- new ios theme
- System option for design system
- Change your login from the login screen
- start on v2
- Torznab search category label: show "Adult" instead of placeholder "XXX"
- Add torrent page: scrollable layout so options and button do not overflow on small screens
- Torrent detail: localized tab labels and loading/error/not-found messages
- Login page: localized connection messages and default server name
- Settings and server preferences: localized update-check messages and preferences saved / not connected
- Torrent list: localized Select All tooltip, selected count, and delete confirmation
- Adaptive navigation: use CupertinoPageRoute when design system is Cupertino (torrent list, settings, server selection)
- Torrent list: Cupertino-style scaffold and nav bar when design system is Cupertino
- Add torrent: Cupertino scaffold with segmented control when design system is Cupertino
- Torrent detail: Cupertino scaffold with segmented control for tabs when design system is Cupertino
- Desktop: minimize/close to system tray using window_manager and tray_manager
- Desktop: global download/upload speed shown in sidebar (Material and Cupertino layouts)
- Torrent list: fix "No Material widget found" for FilterChip when using Cupertino design (wrap filter bar in Material)
- Fix Formatters usage: use formatDownloadSpeed/formatUploadSpeed instead of formatSpeedDown/formatSpeedUp

localizedDescription.en: Initial release of Opentorrent, a cross-platform qBittorrent client that brings seamless torrenting to iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, and the Web.
localizedDescription.zh: 开放种子的首次发布，这是一款跨平台的 qBittorrent 客户端，为 iOS、macOS、Windows、Linux、Android 和 Web 带来无缝的种子下载体验。
localizedDescription.ru: Первоначальный выпуск Opentorrent — кроссплатформенного клиента qBittorrent, который обеспечивает бесперебойную работу с торрентами на iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, Android и в веб-браузере.
